scripts.name: STRATUS - AZURE - Retrieve App Service Publishing Credentials
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for Azure.

Retrieve App Service Publishing Credentials

Retrieves the publishing profile of an Azure App Service (Web App), which contains FTP and Web Deploy credentials in cleartext. An attacker with read-or-higher access to an App Service can call the

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Retrieve App Service Publishing Credentials
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_azure_subscription}" ]; then export AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID="#{stratus_azure_subscription}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=azure.credential-access.app-service-publishing-credentials"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate azure.credential-access.app-service-publishing-credentials
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=azure.credential-access.app-service-publishing-credentials"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"azure.credential-access.app-service-publishing-credentials\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup azure.credential-access.app-service-publishing-credentials
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=azure.credential-access.app-service-publishing-credentials"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT
